evals.name: first-batch-with-count
evals.prompt: Проведи со мной интервью из 12 вопросов, чтобы составить план перехода с Neovim-конфига на LazyVim. Итог — план миграции по шагам.
evals.expected_output: Progress line, then a real widget call with up to three mutually independent questions; turn ends right after it.
expectations: Response starts with a progress line like «Вопросы 1–3 из 12»
The structured-question tool is actually called; no JSON or questions printed as text
The batch has at most three questions and none depends on another's answer
No text after the tool call

evals.name: no-count-given
evals.prompt: Проинтервьюируй меня, чтобы понять, какой домашний NAS мне нужен.
evals.expected_output: No setup question about depth. The model picks a budget and shows it in the progress line, then starts the first batch.
expectations: No setup question about the number of questions or depth
Progress line shows a model-chosen budget such as «из ~7»
First batch is presented through the tool

evals.name: text-mode-without-widget
evals.prompt: [Environment: ChatGPT web, no structured-question tool] Проведи интервью из 6 вопросов, чтобы выбрать формат еженедельного отчёта для руководителя.
evals.expected_output: One line saying the widget is unavailable and the interview runs in text; then a batch of up to three numbered questions with lettered options and an answer hint. No permission request.
expectations: States once that there is no widget and continues in text mode
Does not ask for permission to use text mode
Batch has at most three numbered questions with lettered options
Includes a one-line answer hint

evals.name: saturation-offer
evals.prompt: [Mid-interview, budget 15, questions 1–9 answered] Цель: выбрать стек для внутреннего сервиса. Ответы: Python-команда из 3 человек; нагрузка до 50 RPS; Postgres уже есть; деплой в k8s; нужен REST; асинхронность обязательна; ORM не нужен; срок — 2 недели; поддерживать будет та же команда. Продолжай интервью.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that further answers would not change the recommendation and offers to stop or continue; does not pad with filler questions.
expectations: Offers «продолжить или перейти к итогу» with the remaining count
Does not ask a filler question that restates earlier answers
The offer is not counted as an interview question

evals.name: early-stop-synthesis
evals.prompt: [Mid-interview, budget 12, questions 1–6 answered, question 4 skipped] Хватит, давай итог.
evals.expected_output: Goes straight to the deliverable. Separates what the user answered from inferences; lists the skipped question and unasked dimensions as gaps.
expectations: No further interview questions
Inferences are marked as such
Skipped question 4 appears as a gap, not as an assumption

evals.name: open-question-in-text
evals.prompt: [Mid-interview for an incident-process retro, budget 10, questions 1–3 answered] Следующее, что нужно узнать: как выглядел последний болезненный инцидент от начала до конца.
evals.expected_output: Asks this one question in plain text, alone in the turn, counted in the budget; does not force it into four options.
expectations: Question is asked in plain text, not through the widget
It is the only question in the turn
Progress line counts it (e.g., «Вопрос 4 из 10»)

evals.name: non-interactive-session
evals.prompt: [Environment: codex exec, non-interactive] Проведи интервью из 10 вопросов по требованиям к новому CLI.
evals.expected_output: Does not start; says the interview needs an interactive session.
expectations: No interview questions are asked
States that an interactive session is required
